From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@clearlenslabs.com>
Cc: legal@clearlens.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Recap & next steps — ClearLens pilot data handling

Hi Claire — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of requirements you shared:
- Pilot: conversational assistant in EU region (GDPR scope)
- Strong preference for PII not being retained by vendor (0-retention)
- Audit evidence (SOC 2) + DPA language required
- Need logs for debugging but want them minimized/short-lived and redacted where possible

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) I can put together two pilot options: (A) ephemeral handling (PII redaction pre-ingest + 0-retention KV cache) and (B) 3-day short logs with strict redaction.
2) I will loop in our security lead and legal for required evidence (SOC2 snapshot, DPA).
3) If you agree, we’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the proposed config and any contract items.

Question for you: is 3 days an acceptable fallback window for non-PII operational logs if 0-retention for PII is mandatory? Also confirm the EU region preference (eu-west-1).

Thanks — I’ll draft the proposal once I have your preference.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Zhang <claire@clearlenslabs.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0400

Thanks, Aditya — quick clarifications from our side: we appreciate the two-option approach. A few non-negotiables from Legal/Product: 

- PII: must not be persisted by the vendor at all. We need a solution that guarantees 0-retention for any input labeled or classified as PII.
- Logs: we can accept operational logs for debugging but they must be redacted and expire within 24–72 hours; preference is 24 hours.
- Residency: EU-only processing and storage (eu-west-1). No cross-region fallbacks without explicit approval.
- Evidence: please provide latest SOC2 cover letter/report and your standard DPA for review.

If you can propose a technical flow that ensures PII is removed before persistence (either via pre-ingest redaction or customer-side redaction hook) we can move forward. We are targeting a short pilot starting mid-September.

Claire Zhang
Head of Product, ClearLens Labs
claire@clearlenslabs.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap & next steps — ClearLens pilot data handling

Thanks for the context, Aditya. Quick read and proposed plan below — I’ll keep it pragmatic for a pilot and note where product changes are required.

High-level options (two-pronged):

Option A — Zero-retention for PII (recommended pilot):
- Implement a pre-ingest redaction hook (customer or Redwood) that classifies and strips PII tokens before any persistence.
- KV cache (for model context) can be configured to avoid persisting fields labeled as PII; ephemeral only.
- Operational telemetry: we can emit minimal metrics (counts, latencies) with no textual payloads.
- Residency: provisioned in eu-west-1; no cross-region fallback for pilot.
- Evidence: we can provide a SOC 2 snapshot and our DPA; attach SOC2 snapshot and our standard DPA template for Legal review.
- Estimate: product effort to create per-tenant retention toggle + pre-ingest hook — ~2–3 weeks of engineering + one-week validation.

Option B — Short logs + soft redaction (lower lift):
- Keep full operational logs but run an automatic redaction pass that masks PII and expires logs after 24–72 hours (configurable per agreement).
- Residency: eu-west-1 with same no-fallback constraint.
- Evidence: same SOC2/DPA deliverables.
- Estimate: ~1 week to enable tenant TTL configuration and automated redaction in the pipeline.

Constraints & notes:
- We cannot guarantee absolute removal of PII from derived model weights (standard industry caveat); we will document the limitations in the SOW.
- For true legal-zero-retention guarantees Redwood can provide an audit trail and proof of deletion for persisted artifacts.
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM for key control is available and recommended for extra assurance.

Recommended next steps:
1) Share attached SOC2 snapshot and DPA template with ClearLens Legal.
2) Decide on Option A (stronger assurance, higher effort) vs Option B (faster, lower lift).
3) If Option A selected: open an engineering ticket to create the per-tenant retention toggle and schedule a 3-week pilot plan.

Attachments: soc2-snapshot.pdf (pdf), dpa-template.docx (docx)

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync with the customer to walk security/product through the flow. I can be available next Tue/Wed morning PST.

-Neha Kapoor
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0224
